title: Kyaiktiyo Pagoda
axis: Local +X is true east, up toward the adjoining hill. Local +Z is south on the slope edge.
source: OpenStreetMap named point and surrounding path controls

mappedIdentity.name: Kyaiktiyo Pagoda
mappedIdentity.address: Mount Kyaiktiyo, Kyaikhto Township, Mon State, Myanmar

features.role: Reconstructed immediate rock ledge, bridge and near platform envelope registered to the mapped pagoda point.

identityStatus: The OSM node for Golden Rock and nearby mapped trail, two public-domain site photographs, and the nearby hotel environmental survey documenting the specific shrine dimensions.

terrainContact.basis: Original provider-relative elevation at the mapped point on the boulder contact, with the immediate outcrop represented in model geometry.

notes: A rough, leaf-gilded 7.6 m granite boulder balances on a dark outcrop. Its tapered 7.3 m stupa ends in an open-sided umbrella. A narrow guarded bridge and stone steps connect to the east and lower approach.
